title: Woodworking shop lower west bank, cement plant upper tier of west bank
description: 1958: Steel was stored on the north side of the west abutment. Looking west, you can see the beginnings of at least five cofferdams and the bases of the concrete piers along the causeway. On the first tier above the river to the right are the woodworking buildings, where crews built wooden forms and barrels for the concrete. On the second tier above the river is the cement plant. Sand was hauled from the north island, and rocks were gathered from the riverbed. (MC-1396-5-43 HJF)
